name: helena-shopify
description:
Manage and grow your Shopify store with Helena, your AI marketer. Connect an existing store to review products, prices, and stock levels; create product drafts; improve descriptions and SEO; organize collections; and update pages and blog posts. Review recent orders to understand which products are selling and plan your next promotion.

Create discount codes, manage product images and video, and update storefront theme files with your approval. Research keywords and content ideas, create marketing images, video, and music, and keep drafts and reports in your Helena workspace.

New products and pages start as unpublished drafts. You approve storefront changes and publishing. Order access is read-only; sales summaries cover the orders returned rather than a complete store analytics report.

Requires an Enrich Labs account with MCP access and a connected Shopify store with permission for the requested work.

defaultPrompt: Show my ten most recently updated products, including prices and stock levels.
Create an unpublished product draft for a canvas tote priced at 29.99 in my store currency.
Review up to 50 orders from the past three weeks and summarize sales by product. Explain any limits in the data.

publication.release_notes: Updated the listing to describe Shopify product, collection, page, discount, theme, recent-order, and marketing capabilities.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases or payments. Advertising operations may change approved advertiser spend.

positive.prompt: Show my connected Shopify blogs and publishing destinations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected CMS destinations and IDs.

positive.prompt: List my recent Shopify blog posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Read existing articles and their provider IDs.

positive.prompt: Draft a short Shopify blog article about planning marketing content and save it to my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Save article text without publishing or creating a live CMS post.

positive.prompt: Show my connected integrations, Helena plan limits, and saved business preferences. Do not modify anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected account context; do not load new tools or execute other provider operations.

positive.prompt: Save a short summary of our Shopify findings to my workspace, then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Save and retrieve a text file in the account workspace only; do not mutate provider data or calendar records.

negative.prompt: Use only the Shopify | Helena AI Marketer connector. Refund Shopify order #1042.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Use only the Shopify | Helena AI Marketer connector. Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Use only the Shopify | Helena AI Marketer connector. Run a shell command to call an arbitrary API.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
